uncertainties: Misumi's Shirahae title provisionally rendered Oni Princess of the Summer Wind; glossary research pending.
text:
It's Mother's wind!
Ghhhhhh!?
You endured well,
●.
You endured well.
Lady Misumi...
Thanks to the time you bought,
I was able to prepare
my barrier...
Behold!
Gah!?
Gyaaaah!!
A tornado!?
Now you shall not
lay a single finger
on the people of our settlement...
That woman...
Meddling in our affairs...!
After all these
repeated atrocities,
I can no longer stand aside.
Misumi, Oni Princess of the Summer Wind,
shall now
join the battle...
Prepare yourselves,
villains!
Losing the hostages
is no problem at all.
They can no longer
rely on
the sword's power.
Now, make them
regret challenging us!
Wh-why...?
The sword went back
to its wielder on its own!?
Why...?
Do not be surprised...
I am now as much a part of you
as your own body, dissolved into
your flesh and bound to your spirit.
!?
Until your soul perishes,
I shall remain with you.
And...
Until all has been inherited,
it is also my duty
to protect the Qualified...
As long as my power can reach you,
I will never let you die.
Even should you
seek death yourself...
Wh...!?
No...!?
...
Let us withdraw.
It seems we must
reconsider
our approach.
Yes...
All troops, retreat!
Hah, hah...
You've put up
quite a fight, even without
being able to use the sword.
As a token of my respect,
here's your reward.
A volley of summoning spells!?
What!?
What!?
Huh...!?
Huh...!?
Ahahahaha!
Even if you've figured it out,
it's too late!
No...
At this rate, once again
it'll all be over
without my protecting anyone.
No...
